paragraphs: Advanced Digital Pathway Solutions (ADP) is a Riyadh-headquartered technology company. We design, deliver and operate solutions across five areas, from sovereign AI platforms to blockchain-based trust, for government, public-sector and enterprise clients across the Kingdom, as prime contractor and single accountable partner.

Each of our five solution areas sits in a growing Saudi market: cybersecurity and IoT at double-digit rates, AI and conversational AI at around thirty percent a year, and blockchain fastest of all from a small base. What we bring is local presence, bilingual delivery, end-to-end accountability, and solutions that keep data and AI in the Kingdom.

meta.title: Compliance & trust
meta.description: The frameworks ADP works against, who they apply to and what we deliver: NCA ECC, CCC, DCC, OTCC and CSCC, PDPL, ISO/IEC 27001 and SAMA CSF.

hero.sub: One lifecycle, from first assessment to continuous compliance. We support your compliance; we do not hold or claim regulatory licences on your behalf.

areas.title: The frameworks we work against, and what we deliver for each

items.title: NCA ECC
items.body: Applies to government entities and critical national infrastructure. We deliver gap assessment, a remediation roadmap, a policy set and self-assessment support.

items.title: NCA CCC
items.body: Applies to cloud service providers and cloud consumers. We deliver a cloud security posture review, control mapping and provider due diligence.

items.title: NCA DCC
items.body: Applies to entities handling classified and sensitive data. We deliver data classification, protection controls and watermarking.

items.title: NCA OTCC
items.body: Applies to operators of OT/ICS environments. We deliver an OT asset inventory, segmentation design and OT monitoring.

items.title: NCA CSCC
items.body: Applies to owners of critical systems. We deliver critical-system identification, hardening and testing.

items.title: PDPL (SDAIA)
items.body: Applies to all entities processing personal data in the Kingdom. We deliver data mapping, privacy impact assessments and records of processing.

items.title: ISO/IEC 27001
items.body: Applies to organizations seeking a certified ISMS. We deliver ISMS design, internal audit and certification readiness.

items.title: SAMA CSF
items.body: Applies to banks and SAMA-regulated financial institutions. We deliver a maturity assessment and remediation program.

items.title: SDAIA AI Ethics
items.body: Applies to AI platforms and use cases. In our Sovereign AI stack: AI policy, model evaluation and guardrails, and a blockchain-anchored audit trail.

practices.title: One lifecycle, from first assessment to continuous compliance
items: 1 · Assess: scope, baseline and gap analysis

3 · Remediate: policies, controls and technology
4 · Certify: audit readiness and evidence
5 · Monitor: continuous compliance and SOC

criteria.chip: A 90-day path to the first joint opportunity
items: Weeks 1–2 · Alignment workshop: map your capability to our portfolio and sectors, agree target accounts and use cases, name owners on both sides
Weeks 3–6 · Partner agreement: NDA, partnership model and commercial terms, roles across sales, delivery and support, joint account plan
Weeks 6–10 · Enablement: training and certification for the ADP team, demo environment and joint collateral, joint launch at a client event
Weeks 10–12 · First joint opportunity: select a pilot account and scope a POC, joint go-to-market and pipeline review, quarterly business review
criteria.note: Whatever the model, every deal follows one commercial pattern: a fixed-scope first step, a project, then a managed service, which builds recurring revenue for both sides.
